shortDescription: IIM CAT 2026 Online Form – registration from 3 Aug to 15 Sep 2026 at iimcat.ac.in. Exam on 29 Nov 2026. Apply for MBA/PGP at IIMs and other B-schools.
content:
IIM CAT 2026 (Common Admission Test) online registration will open on the official website iimcat.ac.in. CAT is the national-level entrance exam for admission to MBA/PGP and other management programmes at the Indian Institutes of Management and many other participating business schools.

Important Dates (CAT 2026)

  • Notification: July 2026
  • Registration starts: 03 August 2026, 10:00 AM (IST)
  • Registration ends: 15 September 2026, 5:00 PM (IST)
  • Admit card download: From 04 November 2026
  • Test day: 29 November 2026 (Sunday)

Eligibility

Bachelor’s degree with minimum 50% marks (or equivalent CGPA); 45% for SC/ST/PwD. Final-year graduation candidates can apply as per the official information bulletin.

Application Fee (as notified)

  • General / EWS / NC-OBC: ₹2,700
  • SC / ST / PwD: ₹1,350

Fee is payable online only and is generally non-refundable. Always verify fee and eligibility on iimcat.ac.in before applying.

How to Apply

  1. Open https://iimcat.ac.in
  2. Register with basic details and complete the CAT 2026 application form
  3. Select preferred test cities, upload documents, pay fee and submit
  4. Save the confirmation page / application number for future login

There is no other official website for CAT registration other than iimcat.ac.in.
